name: Boku Kare Kanojo Kanojo to Cobalt Blue
original_name: 僕彼彼女彼女とコバルトブルー
source:
I found an unfamiliar cobalt-blue book in my room.
I have to remember whose it was.
A story of loving and being loved, dying and being lost, falling ill and being consumed.
It offers many different kinds of happy endings.
